platformKey.description: OS-family platform key referenced by host entries

justification.description: Why this entry is not managed on this platform.

hostEntryBase.description: Common host-entry shape: requires a platform ref and forbids legacy flag keys. Runtime-specific fields (service/launchctl, kind/login-item, etc.) are added by each registry's own host-entry definition via allOf.

hostsParity.description: Host-key parity wrapper: requires the canonical host keys (MacBook/NixOS/Windows). Each host value type is supplied by the consuming schema via allOf (e.g. hostEntry / hostAutostartEntry). Enforces the parity-first rule at validation time.

schemaProperty.description: Reference to the JSON Schema file that validates this data file.
